title: How PepsiCo goes from dashboards to outcomes and deep research with Genie

segments.text: [music]
>> Welcome to the stage PepsiCo's global
chief data and AI officer Magesh
Bhagavathy
and Databricks co-founder Arsalan
Tavakoli.
>> All right.
So Magesh you showed a pretty cool demo
out there talking about Genie but here
we're about to talk about all the
amazing things that Pepsi's been doing.
Um I'm sure everybody out here is
familiar they just saw the video but
you guys are pretty massive and complex
business but best in class when it comes
to AI transformation. So how about you
tell me a little bit about that?
>> Well thank you Arsalan. It's fantastic
to be here. Great crowd very talented
crowd and I'm here to represent team
PepsiCo.
And uh you know this journey started off
for us around 6 years back as we were
really initiating our full-blown
end-to-end digital transformation and
process transformation as well.
And the focus has always been faster for
our customers and consumers stronger for
our people products and our businesses
and ensuring we're better for the
planet. So that's been the core mission
of PepsiCo.
And as we talk about the size and scale
of PepsiCo sometimes it amazes myself.
Right? Um
we have 320,000 employees globally,
operate around 200 countries. And this
is continuous non-stop operation. We
have, I don't know, some of you might
not know, we have one of the largest
fleets in North America. So, when you
have this level of complexity,
you also want to most importantly be
able to service your consumers.
And one of the things we measure how we
service the consumers is occasions.
We do around 1.4 billion occasions a
day. An occasion is, you saw all the
great products in the video,
it is really how you all consume our
fantastic products every day. So, that's
what we call as an occasion.
So, when you have to service these
occasions through 6 million retailers
and also your e-B2B and e- and and D2C
avenues, it's a pretty complex endeavor.
So, for us, what we truly believe is an
AI transformation is a data
transformation. And that's what we've
undertaken. So, what the team has done
really is fundamentally over the last 6
years really moved us from a legacy
architecture where we had 60 plus data
lakes to one lakehouse right now running
on Databricks. And also from
a monolithic architecture to a truly
pluggable LEGO-based architecture. That
transformation for us is really how we
start unlocking the value of the data
that's in this platform because now 90%
of PepsiCo's universe, data universe, is
now on the platform. And this which is
what we call as enterprise data
foundation. So, for us, this is a living
breathing platform that we double down
on.
>> That's awesome. And look, you were one
of the early ones that talked to us
about Genie. I know you had efforts
internally and you basically came to Ali
and I and you're like, we have to build
something like this.
Uh, why has Genie been such a
game-changer for you guys?
>> Uh, yes, we did come to you guys a few
years back. And this was when we were
actually, as we started onboarding all
this data into the platform, we saw that
this is going to be so much richness
this platform can offer for us in terms
of the core capabilities. We call this
AI for BI and our ability to dialogue
with data. Whether it's a warehouse
operator, whether it's a frontline
employee, or whether it's a knowledge
worker, we want to be able to dialogue
with data just as Ken showed.
And for us, as we were looking at this
AI for BI consoles, it was taking us
anywhere between 3 to 6 months as you
want to vectorize it, you want to rag,
do do rag patterns, and try to bring the
data on board and really then start
executing this. As we are having
conversations, we were starting to see,
you know, the accuracy was not where we
wanted it to be. So, that's why it was
taking 3 to 6 months to productionize.
And this is when we reached out to to
you guys.
So, at this point in time, having almost
uh accurate and and catalog data in the
enterprise data foundation, for us Genie
is all about unlocking the value from
the Databricks environment.
So,
>> that's kind of an amazing story. Now,
bring that home for me. Make it real,
right? You guys actually have actual use
cases of how you've been using it. And I
know even though you're getting started,
talk to me about some of the value and
how you've been using it.
>> Yeah, it's not real until you
productionize it, right?
And um
what we have in PepsiCo's an ambition is
we want to identify PepsiCo.
And as we think about identifying
PepsiCo, we think about concepts such as
the supply chain AI brain. One of the
components of the supply chain AI brain
is the procurement brain.
Very strong uh sponsorship from our
chief procurement officer to really
start looking at insights for all things
procurement, both direct and indirect
spend.
We're a $95 billion revenue company. So,
there is a decent amount of direct and
indirect spend.
So um
within this platform called Spend Wise,
where our procurement leaders and our
key senior leaders operate to understand
what their overall indirect spend is,
we've had dashboards, capabilities, and
reports. But as we unleashed Genie
within that that space,
it was truly a big game changer. Just in
the first few weeks of launch, we almost
had 30,000 queries, engagements back and
forth. And all of a sudden you start
seeing this user population shift from
reports and dashboards into a Genie type
engagement. One of the things I love
about Genie Genie by the way, is a
little bit of what Ken showed, was that
ability for you to go into agent mode
and really then start looking at deep
research.
So, you have tremendous amount of
flexibility within the platform, which
is what me and a lot of the leaders
within PepsiCo really like. And now what
we're looking to do is we're now looking
to expand this use case across all parts
of PepsiCo including commercial
reporting for Europe and also for Latin
America as well.
>> Fair enough. And then I know they're
going to yell at us cuz we're running
late, but I'd be remiss to not ask you,
you know, what's next for you guys? You
guys have such ambitions of what you
want to drive. So, what's next?
>> You know, for us it's all about how do
we get to an agentic PepsiCo. And we've
got huge ambitions. For us it's really
about going from insights to action to
outcomes for our end user and for our
population. So, our goal is now to go
from these 30,000 plus reports down to
50 plus AI for BI or Genie consoles.
That's a big outcome for us. That's how
we're going to drive our our business
going forward. This will really help us
agentify PepsiCo. help us
agentify our 320,000 associates.
>> Awesome. Well, it's been an incredible
journey and excited to see what comes
next. Thanks so much.
>> Thanks Ron. Thanks for the partnership.
>> Appreciate it.
>> Thank you all.
>> [music]
